DamageEnemy evaluates ((quantity+1)/2) before hitPoints and compares halfDamage > damage. Values and damage arithmetic are unchanged.
Damage compares kills > quantity and uses quantity -= kills, recovering the retail word subtraction.
behavior_review: Luck rolls retain the existing asymmetry: positive luck uses roll <= luck, negative luck uses roll < -luck, with rolls in 1..12.
The no-hero return still precedes resetting m_luck; this existing control flow is preserved.
Sample loading, Wince/Stand and good/bad SpellEffect calls retain the same order and 180 delay.
No new movement, damage, genie-half or death/retaliation behavior difference found in these eight routines beyond the plural-name luck messages.
